title: Think Inside the Chunk: RegulaRAG for Regulation-Compliant Scenario Generation using LLMs: A Case Study of UN Regulation No. 152
abstract: arXiv:2608.16394v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generating regulation-compliant test scenarios is essential for validating safety-critical automotive systems, yet Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle to ground outputs in long, hierarchical standards. We present RegulaRAG, a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline that couples SmartChunking, reference-aware enrichment of paragraphs and tables via graph traversal, with Smart Retrieve & Rerank over these enriched units. To test our system, we evaluate on a manually curated dataset covering all scenarios in UN Regulation No. 152 (AEBS). Our study comprises: (i) a three-step progressive search that identifies near-optimal retrieval parameters without exhaustive grid search; (ii) head-to-head comparisons against five baseline RAG systems; and (iii) a robustness stress test that scales the source corpus with distractor content. translated_title: 在块内思考：使用LLM生成符合法规场景的RegulaRAG方法——以联合国第152号法规为例
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16394v1 公告类型：新 摘要：生成符合法规的测试场景对于验证安全关键的汽车系统至关重要，然而大型语言模型（LLMs）在将输出锚定于冗长、层级化的标准时存在困难。我们提出了RegulaRAG，一种检索增强生成（RAG）流水线，它结合了SmartChunking（通过图遍历对段落和表格进行参考感知的丰富化处理）和Smart Retrieve & Rerank（对这些丰富化单元进行智能检索与重排序）。为了测试我们的系统，我们在一个手工整理的涵盖联合国第152号法规（AEBS）中所有场景的数据集上进行了评估。我们的研究包括：（i）三步渐进式搜索，无需穷举网格搜索即可找到接近最优的检索参数；（ii）与五个基线RAG系统的直接对比；（iii）通过干扰内容扩展源语料库的鲁棒性压力测试。输出使用自定义的惩罚性评分指标进行评估。在所有实验中，RegulaRAG均实现了显著优势。
tldr: RegulaRAG通过智能分块和参考感知的检索增强生成技术，有效解决了LLM在生成符合复杂法规场景时的问题，并在联合国第152号法规测试中显著优于现有基线系统。
en_tdlr: RegulaRAG effectively addresses LLM grounding in complex regulations via smart chunking and reference-aware retrieval-augmented generation, significantly outperforming baseline systems on UN Regulation No. 152 scenarios.
